summary: English and Indonesian first-party discovery identified the official BHUMI/ATLAS cadastral viewer and the local Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Banjarnegara. Current viewer JavaScript identifies Geoserver layer umum:Persil at /bhumigs/umum, but direct WFS/WMS route checks returned 404 and the viewer proxy returned an HTML-to-JSON error. No anonymous safe parcel ID-plus-geometry response was qualified and no sample was retained.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All executed discovery queries, URLs, viewer configuration inspection, endpoint checks, response outcomes, schema/CRS checks, safe field allowlist, scope limits, and uncertainty are recorded in city-6843-banjarnegara.json. No login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, credentials, private tokens, TLS bypass, or unsafe-field request occurred.
